title: Mafia 24: The Battle of Cherbourg
narrative_chronicle:
### Chapter 1: The Gathering
May 1944. The air in the Fort du Roule was thick with the scent of ozone, fear, and the lingering acridity of burnt documents. As Allied forces hammered the coast of Cherbourg, the German high command found itself fractured not just by external artillery, but by internal rot. Whispers circulated through the mess hall; some among them were not loyalists, but clandestine American saboteurs tasked with ensuring the fort's intelligence would never reach Berlin.

### Chapter 2: First Blood
Suspicion turned to paranoia as the soldiers looked over their shoulders, dreading the knife in the dark. The primary target of the mob's ire was Deci. Despite his frantic pleas—insisting on his loyalty to the Reich and his disdain for the Allied cause—the court turned a deaf ear. As the lugers clicked into place, Deci bolted toward the emergency exit, shouting his innocence to the wind. A single shot rang out. He fell, a martyr to his own perceived guilt, only for a thorough search of his quarters to reveal the truth: Deci was innocent. The Town had shed the blood of one of its own.

### Chapter 3: Web of Deceit
The nights grew long and lethal. While the fortress walls held against the P-47s, the silence within was punctuated by the sound of muffled gunfire and sliding bodies. Melvin, Iluvatar, and Dispo became the central architects of the endgame. The struggle shifted from the battlefield to the very heart of the command structure. Allegiances were brittle, and the "Oberst"—the leader of the defense—found that command was a heavy, and often deadly, crown.

### Chapter 4: The Final Stand
As the Allies neared the gates, the betrayal reached its crescendo. Melvin, revealed as an Allied infiltrator, attempted a desperate gambit to seize the tactical notes. He burst into the mess hall, iron blazing, but his aim was betrayed by his nerves. In the ensuing chaos, he managed to strike Iluvatar, but the resistance was fierce. 

The corridors of the fort became a graveyard. Petrostone, an American operative, was gunned down by his own brother-in-arms, Melvin, in a tragic case of mistaken identity and panic. Finally, Dispo delivered the killing blow to the American saboteur, Melvin, only to face the cold steel of TU. But the final twist belonged to the remaining loyalists; Iluvatar and Dispo, scarred and bloodied, stood amidst the ruins of the intelligence files. With the American threat neutralized and the secrets consigned to the furnace, they awaited the inevitable end, having held their ground until the very last.

## 🏆 Endgame Resolution & Role Reveals

June 26thFort du Roule, CherbourgThe formidable bastion stood tall and secure against the back of the city. The large guns in the lower level of the fortress had been pumping large calibre bullets onto the sea line non stop since this morning, fending off the allied forces who started the siege from the seafront. An anti tank ditch had been dug several hundred yards south of the fort and the automatic weapons on top of the bastion were firing with pause at the enemy soldiers on the ground.Generalleutnant von Schlieben peered through one of the narrow windows, he was watching the attacks from his large office. The fortress stood strong, but the allied forces had thinned out his troops and he was not sure how long he could last. If only..A squadron of P-47's flew over and a massive load of bombs were released. Explosions ravaged all over Fort du Roule, but the bombs had missed the key gun locations and so they could continue to lay fire with onto the attacking allied troops. But these bombings had set the final attacks in motion, things seemed to come to an end very soon.von Schlieben looked up and noticed a young gefreiter entering the room. He cleared his throat and ordered the young officer to contact the intelligence office right away. "Inform them of our situation. Make sure they know what to do. No intelligence should fall into their hands". --- A cold chill ran from the bottom of his back slowly to his neck. He shrugged it off and sighed; "what to do.. what to do". He ejected the clip on his luger and checked if everything was in order. He knew it would be, but still. He quietly opened the door and looked down the passage before leaving his room.He walked down the hall and peered through the little window next to the door to the mess hall. He noticed Iluvatar and Dispo dragging around the last boxes containing tactical notes, letters, maps and such alike. The large furnace had been lit, for obvious purposes.Melvin stepped away from the window and took a long deep breath. His heart was pounding like it had never pounded before. He had to act before he would lose his nerve. His hand slowly reached the doorknob, the metal feeling cold again his skin. With force he threw open the door jumped inside. He raised his pistol and started firing before he would lose his advantage.His hand was not steady at all and the bullets just hit the wall behind Iluvatar and Dispo, who by now had grabbed their own hand guns and returned fire. Both sides kept firing while seeking cover behind the tables and chairs. One of his bullets managed to find his way through the overthrown tables and hit Iluvatar in the shoulder. He reloaded his own luger and awaited the recognizable clicking sound of an empty luger. 'click click click' ..there it was. Melvin got up and decided to run to the kitchen and seek cover there. Iluvatar tried to hit the running American, but his hurt shoulder made him a poor marksman, allowing Melvin to slide behind a counter.Petrolstone was running down the hall way, attempting to evade his pursuer TU, who was firing at him from only a few meters further down the corridor. PS turned the corner and opened the door to the kitchen. He barged into the kitchen, but fell over a tiny cabinet, crashing into a larger cupboard. He removed a shard of broken plate that go stuck in his leg, while he pulled himself up. The wound hurt badly, but he had to continue before TU caught up. He stumbled along several cabinets and buffets towards the second part of the kitchen. He came around the corner and.. * BANG * PS looked down at the gaping bleeding hole that was in the middle of chest. He looked up and saw that it was Melvin who shot him, Melvin.. his brother in arms."NOOOOooOoooooooo PS.. NOoo" Melvin crawled towards his brother. He started shaking PS around, telling him not to give up, to hang in there. But it was too late. PS was gone.Meanwhile Dispo had manoeuvred himself behind of the large stoves and now had a clear shot at Melvin. "STERBST! DU AMERIKANISCHER SCHWEINHUND!" he yelled while he shot Melvin twice in the back of the head. He stood up, but froze up at the cold feeling of a metal object being placed against the back of his head. He slowly turned around, facing TU's black luger P08. "Melvin was an annoying dick, but he was still an American" TU spoke. "You lose"* BANG *Iluvatar dropped his pistol and smiled at Dispo. The smiling hurt his shoulder, but it didn't matter any more. TU, the allied commander had been killed, it was all over now.Dispo walked towards the furnace and grabbed the last boxes and threw the valuable intelligence into the fire. His first action as new Oberst, hopefully and probably not his last.Outside the sound of gunfire and grenades seem to draw closer and closer. It would not be long until Cherbourg would completely fall into the hands of the allied forces. --- GAME OVER.CONGRATULATIONS TO DISPO AND ILUVATAR.Elrohir"Abstract art is the product of the untalented, sold by the unprincipled to the utterly bewildered.."

### Chapter 1: The Androids of Sestu
Under the harsh crimson glow of the Red Dwarf star, the planet Sestu hummed with synthetic life. In the industrial heart of Losana, military androids were being manufactured in mass, but a glitch—a biological contamination of the circuit board—had allowed a faction of saboteurs to infiltrate the town. The townspeople were restless, their paranoia amplified by the mechanical clicking of the factory machines. Whispers of "mobsters" and "android infiltrators" filled the streets.

### Chapter 2: First Blood
The night air was pierced by a single gunshot. Thirdrock, acting as the town’s investigator, had been staking out the outskirts, hoping to unmask a rogue synth. He never saw the end of his watch; the darkness claimed him before the sun could rise over the cliffside. The town awoke to find their primary scout cold and lifeless. The tension was palpable; accusations flew between Evil Jets and Anarchy, with the latter defending his absence as a mere trip for a haircut. The seeds of distrust had been sown, and the town began to splinter.

### Chapter 3: Web of Deceit
Chaos reigned in the factory. As the second night fell, a shadowy figure—the town's "Bus Driver"—attempted a desperate maneuver. Predicting a strike by the Syndicate, the Driver switched the fates of two targets, hoping to deflect the kill. The plan backfired in a tragic twist of irony: AdriusAvangion, a hopeful soul who had only just arrived in Losana, was struck down in place of the intended target. The town mourned, but the silence of the survivors was deafening. Even as the mobster "Cupid" boasted of his kills, the realization hit home: the town had lost its most capable protectors.

### Chapter 4: The Final Stand
With information scarce and the mob’s influence growing, the community began to crumble. The logic of the investigators had been overruled by the chaotic finger-pointing of the terrified. The factory's output ceased, and the residents of Losana found themselves trapped in a game where every word spoken was a potential death warrant. The records fade here, but the legacy of Mafia 10111 remains: a stark reminder that even on the edge of the galaxy, the most dangerous enemy is the one hiding behind a friendly face.

title: Mafia in Review
narrative_chronicle:
### Chapter 1: The Gathering of Archives
The atmosphere in the Imperial Conflict chambers was thick, not with the scent of gunpowder or the sting of betrayal, but with the dust of forgotten ledgers. Moderator K, acting as a curator of the realm's fading memory, emerged from the void with a plea—a call to reconstruct the lost history of the community. It was a search for truth, a quest to tally the fallen and codify the secret roles that had once shaped the destiny of the Empire.

### Chapter 2: The Inquiry
The call was answered by the Chronicler Elrohir and the vigilant [RPA] Arocalex. No daggers were drawn; no lynch mobs formed under the moonlight. Instead, a debate sparked over the fragility of record-keeping. Elrohir lamented the loss of Arsy’s ancient statistical scrolls, while Arocalex pondered the mathematical impossibility of reconstruction without the raw data of the fallen. They stood at the precipice of history, realizing that the records were not merely incomplete—they were effectively ghosts, leaving the "Mafia in Review" as an unfinished epitaph in the annals of the game.

### Chapter 3: The Silent Void
As the ink dried on the final post, the realization settled over the chamber: the game had dissolved into a quiet administrative uncertainty. Without a definitive end, the story of this review remains an open-ended mystery. The history was not written in blood, but in the echoes of a community trying to remember who they once were, leaving the final tally to the whispers of the archives.

title: Mafia: Galactic Flight 0022
narrative_chronicle:
### Chapter 1: The Gathering
Flight 0022 was meant to be a marvel of human ingenuity, a smooth, turbulence-free passage to the Luxos Capital. But within the luxurious cabins, a darker agenda was brewing. Among the 22 passengers, an insurgency lay dormant, waiting for the solar winds to provide the perfect cover. As the ship shook, a hidden suitcase burst open to reveal weaponry, and the serenity of the flight was shattered by the cold-blooded execution of the cockpit crew. The ship was now a tomb, drifting aimlessly through the void.

### Chapter 2: First Blood
Chaos reigned as the passengers realized their pilots were dead. In the vacuum of leadership, paranoia took root. The town attempted to organize, electing Genesis as their Captain, but their efforts were hampered by the shadows stalking the corridors. The Serial Killer, a rogue element in the madness, claimed their first victim, while the Mafia, led by an unknown Godfather, systematically hunted those who posed a threat to their hostile takeover.

### Chapter 3: Web of Deceit
The passenger list grew shorter with every passing day. The Doctor (ARFeh) and the Cops tried to hold the line, investigating whispers and pinning the blame on suspected conspirators. However, the Mafia’s reach was absolute. They silenced the Cops, removed the town's protectors, and masterfully manipulated the lynch votes to dispose of anyone standing in their way—such as the unfortunate Anarchy, who was sacrificed to their machinations.

### Chapter 4: The Final Stand
As the ship’s oxygen levels dwindled and the end grew near, the surviving conspirators made their move. Thirdrock, the orchestrator, ended the charade by descending upon Captain Genesis in his office, silencing the last beacon of hope. With ruthless efficiency, Melvin, Amok, and Lexuzis turned on the remaining passengers. As the final cries of the innocent faded into the cold silence of space, the Mafia stood triumphant among the wreckage—the true masters of Flight 0022.

He stopped for a moment and looked at his watch, the crash had given it a large crack, but the time was still readable. Almost time for the lynch, he stated out loud.A few quarters down on the beach was the bunk of Undeath. After the death of his old room-mate Destroyyoutoo, he had made room for Skyroshroud. Both being 20 and all, they seemed to get along just fine. They were playing a bit of poker to pass the time.Elsewhere.."No Melvin, lynch is written L - Y - N - C - H" KT said as she put down the notebook. She had tried to teach him some proper spelling and grammar, but it seemed the guy just didn't get it. Melvin sat down in the sand looking a bit woebegone.In another bunk on the beach..."They just don't believe me" Anarchy said as he looked in piece of broken mirror that he had found on the beach. "It will get us all KILLED" he yelled at Amok who was standing guard until the lynch."Ah what the hell, you are a dirty mobster too, why am I even trying". He kicked against the small wooden footstool (something he had also found on the beach) and cursed loudly. Feeling so powerless, it was killing him. --- Thirdrock was walking down the beach, looking at bright stars that lit up the sky. He looked happy tonight and why not? Tonight he would take control and the Mafia would rise in full glory. He grabbed the golden pocket watch from his back pocket and stared at the clock hands slowly reaching the designated time. He snapped to lid shut and whispered: "It is time".He had now arrived at one of the quarters and he removed the flap in front of the Captain's office. Genesis - honestly surprised by the gunman entering his office - immediately understood the error they had made by blaming Anarchy. He closed his eyes whilst Thirdrock popped three bullets into Genesis' chest. The Captain and honest townie was no more.Melvin took the knife he had stashed away and grabbed KT by her hair. He pulled her head back and slit her throat quick and without any remorse. "SPEL THIS BITSJ, M - O - B !!!" he grinned as he dropped the bloody knife.Meanwhile Anarchy was still busy over thinking what he had done to be accused so wrongly. He had not noticed that Amok had left his post until he saw Amok standing behind him trough the mirror. Amok grabbed Anarchy's head and bashed it against the mirror. The mirror cracked and blood started to seep through the cracks. More blood and more cracks surfaced as Amok bashed Anarchy's head against the wall over and over, until there was no drip of blood left to spill.Only two more to go. Lexuzis - being a professional hitman and all - knew that it wouldn't be any problem. He grabbed two beautiful curved knifes from his jacket and clenched his fights tight while peering through the opening of the bunk. He took a moment and walked a few steps back. Sprinting towards the bunk he ran through the opening holding the two knifes, ready to strike. Both Skyroshroud and Undeath had no idea what was happening and how could they, things went so incredibly fast. One of the knifes was already plunged into Undeath's heart before Skyro even saw who it was that they were dealing with. He tried to defend himself, but that deck of cards was no defence for Lex his sharpened knifes. Knifes meant for one purpose only, to kill. Lex stabbed skyro twice in the belly before grabbing his head and cutting his throat. Lex didn't look back as he left the bunk and walked towards the others who were united on the beach.Thirdrock, Lexuzis, Melvin and Amok; the survivors, the mobsters the winners!Congratulations.Elrohir"Abstract art is the product of the untalented, sold by the unprincipled to the utterly bewildered.."

title: Mafia: Writers Unlimited.
narrative_chronicle:
### Chapter 1: The Writer’s Block
The air in the Imperial Archives was thick with the scent of stagnant ink and the desperate sighs of deadline-haunted authors. Moderator Elrohir, faced with a blank page and a looming deadline, beckoned the community to assist in weaving a tapestry of blood and prose. The atmosphere was one of high-strung intellectualism; they discussed the merits of abstract art, the nuances of grammar, and the heavy toll of academic life.

### Chapter 2: The Collaboration of Chaos
The gathering was defined not by action, but by the negotiation of labor. [RPA] Eltara, buried under the weight of pedagogical duties, offered only cynical advice to make the game "bloody, gory, and disgusting." Meanwhile, Torqez and Evil Jets pleaded the complications of traffic and GMT scheduling, their participation flickering like a dying candle in a drafty hallway. The tension mounted as Skyroshroud mocked the literary pretenses of the group, demanding the inclusion of crude, poorly written tropes, while [RPA] Arocalex nursed an ancient grudge against the Moderator, refusing to lend a pen to the cause.

### Chapter 3: The Unfinished Manuscript
As the debate over grammar and narrative structure stalled, the game descended into a meta-fictional entropy. The Yell proposed a "Mad Libs" approach to the murders, stripping the mystery of its soul and reducing the death scenes to a modular template. The climax never truly arrived. In a final, cryptic stroke, Elrohir posted a simple "lol," abandoning the characters to a purgatory of unfinished plot points and uncommitted crimes. The writers had become the art itself: unprincipled, bewildered, and—above all—silent.

title: Irc Mafia
narrative_chronicle:
### Chapter 1: The Gathering at #ircMafia
The air in the digital ether of the early 2000s crackled with static and ambition. A call went out across the servers: *#ircMafia* was open for business. A motley crew of internet wanderers—Listos, Painintheass, evilsheep, Wild Flower Soul, Elrohir, and the boisterous [RPA] Arocalex—assembled under the watchful, if inscrutable, eye of the moderator, Evil Jets. They sought the thrill of the hunt, a "fast-paced" distillation of the classic social deduction game that had captivated forum-goers for years.

### Chapter 2: The Discordant Chorus
Before the first blade was drawn in the dark, the players circled one another like wolves. The chatter was thick with bravado and philosophical posturing. Listos dismissed the newcomers as "noobs," while Wild Flower Soul expressed a hesitant, fearful respect for the speed of the impending chaos. [RPA] Arocalex played the role of the agitator, hurling insults at the "slobs" who lingered, demanding action. Behind the screen of bravado and quotes about abstract art and the invention of the radio, the true game remained shrouded. It was a gathering of pretenders and contenders, each hoping to navigate the dark waters of deception.

### Chapter 3: The Silent Fade
In the cold, clinical architecture of the IRC chat, the "game" dissolved as quickly as it had formed. Despite the initial fervor and the call to arms by Evil Jets, the thread collapsed under the weight of its own brevity. No blood was spilled, no accusations reached a fever pitch, and the detectives never truly took their stand. Like a radio signal lost to the atmospheric noise of Springfield, the match vanished into the archives, leaving behind only the ghosts of a lobby that never quite ignited into the war it promised.

title: Mafia 21: Incarceration at Rae
narrative_chronicle:
### Chapter 1: The Gathering at Rae
The portal flared a malevolent blue, depositing a new cohort of prisoners onto the desolate, hellish surface of Rae. These were the dregs of the Arsylian galaxy: thieves, murderers, and the whispered-about members of the Arsylian Mafia. As the newcomers were stripped of their dignity and possessions, a grim realization settled over the camp. The anarchy of Rae was no longer enough; the convicts, fearing a shadow-enslavement by the Mob, turned to the makeshift court. They began to vote, casting their peers into the void in a desperate, blind attempt to purge the organized rot from their ranks.

### Chapter 2: First Blood
The silence of the kangaroo-dung hovels was shattered by the sound of splintering wood. Torqez, a simple poacher, was the first to fall—crushed beneath his own home by the ruthless hands of the Arsylian Mafia. But the Mob was not the only reaper on Rae. Arfeh, a loud-mouthed agitator, found himself ensnared in a nightmare of honey and swarming, ravenous rats—the signature, sadistic hallmark of the lone Serial Killer. The morning sun rose over a double grave, and the barbecue that followed was tainted by the metallic taste of fear.

### Chapter 3: The Mirror-Eater’s Fall
Suspicion turned toward the eccentric, and eyes fell upon Melvin, a self-proclaimed mirror-eater whose desperate attempts to divert blame onto others only sealed his fate. In a display of raw prison brutality, the convicts took the law into their own hands. Following a chorus of crude suggestions, Nolio led the charge, and Melvin’s life was extinguished in the dust. The court cheered, yet as the body cooled, the whispers persisted: the "justice" of the crowd had claimed yet another innocent soul, leaving the true predators to walk free.

### Chapter 4: The Final Stand
As the night descended again, the carnage intensified. Shlimy, the simple farmboy, met his end by piano wire, while Elbekko, the digital hermit, suffered a gruesome crucifixion at the hands of the Serial Killer. The prisoners awoke to find a landscape littered with corpses—both human and bovine. With the toll of casualties rising and the Mafia’s grip tightening, the convicts faced the ultimate question: had they already lost the battle for their own survival, or could they find the true wolves hiding among the sheep before the portal closed on them forever?

## 📜 Opening Briefing & Lore
*Original opening by Moderator **Elrohir***

Pinwheel, Planet Arsylia, Capitol CityThree elderly gentlemen were sipping tea and eating biscuits at Cafe Guillotin's terrace near the town square. Their appearance was of nobility and wisdom. They talked calmly of things that had happened in their formerly small town had that grown into a metropolitan at an incredible speed. With econimical growth, the downsides had also appeared. The city had seen a huge rise in organised crime, chiefly the group known as Arsylian Mafia. As the men were getting ready to order more biscuits, a black transport flew past them at a hurried pace. The men stopped talking as they watched it go. It quickly vanished between the skyscrapers."There goes another prisoner transport to the portal. I wonder if it will ever end", spoke one of the men."It should encourage others not to seek the criminal way of life, bishop", replied a man next to him who looked slightly doggish. "And it's a one-way trip through the portal, to another galaxy. The prison planets are foolproof and there's no coming back from them."Sagittarius Dwarf, System 55,46, Prison planet 7 "Rae"Rae was a secluded prison planet that had been put into use as more and more industrialised planets had begun to struggle with rising prisoner populations. The planet had a special oneway portal that worked only one way: You could get onto the planet, but not away from it. As maximum security prisons go, a designated planet for prisoners was the best anyone had come up with so far. No guards, no upkeep costs. As one might guess, the planet's population was less than pleasant: Murderers, sexual deviants, thieves, televangelists, mobsters, and so forth. But still the convicts had installed rudimentary signs of civilisation. They had built lodgings and they even had a makeshift court that was rarely used as there was really not much law to speak of. Everything was ran with principles of anarchy.Convicts watched as the portal begun to glow blue again as a sign of incoming travellers. They were suspicious, even more so than usual. Recently many of the new prisoners were suspected of being members of organised crime, and there were rumours that the Arsylian Mafia wanted to enslave the other prisoners as their servants. For the first time in a long while the court system had been put to use. Every day they'd gather by the portal and vote for the execution of someone who they thought was a mobster. Of course, there was no saying how the Mob would react to this. Tt was likely they'd respond with violence and skip their original plan of enslaving the regular convicts.When the new arrivals came through the portal, they were quickly beaten and their few possessions were stolen. "Welcome to Rae", grinned one of the convicts as he was pulling off a newcomers' shoes. --- As usual, the following are the list of characters. These will be allocated to players who sign up randomly using a randomize tool.8 Mobsters (including a Mafia elected Godfather and two pro mob secret role)1 Martyr1 Pro town secret role1 Serial Killer2 Snitches1 Dealer11 Townies=> 25 playersAdditional role - The Elder.Additional roles - Two random people will be the lovers.Only the godfather and Mafia will know who the other mobsters are. Everyone else will be in the dark.NIGHT PHASE - WHO DOES WHAT?Each phase of the game begins with the night. The following can happen during this time:- Before the end of the first night, the Mafia must elect their godfather. The godfather is the leader of the Mafia. He, together with the other mobsters, will decide on person to kill each night. He will also choose one of them to conduct the kill. The godfather has the final say in any Mafia night decision. He will also appear to be innocent to the sheriff's investigations and is immune to being killed at night.- The serial killer is a madman who kills one person every night. Like the Godfather, he is immune to being killed/cured at night and will only die if lynched.- The Martyr is an heroic madman who has the ability to kill one person once in the game. Unfortunately the martyr will not survive an attack on the Mafia.- The snitches have the power to investigate one inmate per night. By daytime, he will discover this person's role. He can do what he likes with this information but revealing it might reveal his identity. (formerly known as the cops)- The Dealer has the ability to save one person per night. That person will be protected from any possible attack by the Mafia or serial killer. The dealer is forbidden from choosing the same person two nights in a row and he cannot choose himself. (formerly known as the doctor)- The two lovers are so in love that they share the same fate. Might one die, the other will commit suicide. Obviously they will know who their lover is, but won't know their lover's role. (This love connection can be a connection between any two kinds of roles). Their ultimate goal is to survive together. If they are left over together then they win, whatever role they both have.- The Elder of Rae - is an additional role, which means it is on top of your given role. The elder has two votes in every lynching and is elected by the town on day 1. Upon death, the elder chooses his or her predecessor. (formerly known as the mayor)DAY PHASE - LYNCHINGDuring the day phase, everyone in the town will find out who has been murdered. All townsfolk (including the mafia, the serial killer, dealer and snitches) can then vote who they think are mobsters. This is the lynching process. There will be a deadline to which the people must vote by. If there is a draw, the deadline will be extended and only those drawing will be voted on. If there is still a draw by the new deadline, there will be no lynching. Once the result is in, the person will then be dead and their role will be revealed. Then that round is over and night begins again when the night roles make their next choices.WHO WINS?The godfather and his Mafia will win if they manage to kill everyone else off. The serial killer wins if he is the last person alive and the rest win if they manage to kill off all the mafia and kill the serial killer.Everyone is allowed to post in the thread to discuss who they think is infected or try to make themselves less suspicious (if they are Mafia!). You may NOT quote any part of messages sent by the game moderators. Doing so will result in your sudden death. Also, when you die you are dead and are no longer part of the game, you are not allowed to discuss the game with anyone.Helping with the modding this game is Deci!FULL PLAYER LIST:1. Prisoner number 11. Torqez. Sentenced for poaching, hunted kiwis.Torqez slept uneasily in his hovel made of kangaroo dung. It had taken him quite a while to find enough on this planet were kangaroos were rare animals, but his homesickness had prevailed and he had spent months gathering the kangaroo manure. The smell of kangaroos reminded him of his wife who he hadn't seen since he had been sent to Rae. Little did he know that outside his hovel, mobsters had gathered. They carefully removed the pieces of wood that held the hovel together. When the structure was weakened, one of the mobsters gave the hovel a good kick. It collapsed, sending in air fumes of old kangaroo dung. Torqez didn't even have time to wake up. He was buried under kangaroo dung and choked to death. Mafia had drawn first blood: Torqez was a regular townie. --- Prisoner number 3, Arfeh. Sentenced for treason, called queen mother of his home planet "an old harlot".Arfeh was in his tent sharpening pointy sticks. He was planning on settling some old scores. There was also a sweet smell in the air. He looked down and saw that his groin area had been covered in honey. Just when he was wondering if he was going to be a victim of especially kinky prison rape, he saw a bag appear at the top of the hole. In the annals of Imperial Conflict history, the file labeled "Mafia 22!!" stands as a haunting testament to potential unfulfilled. Recruits gathered, their dossiers prepared, hearts beating with the nervous anticipation of a hunt yet to begin.

The atmosphere grew thick with the scent of ozone and tension, yet the mechanisms of the game never churned. The mission ended before it began, vanishing into the archives of the "What If." It remains the Great Stillness, a game that exists only as a phantom entry in the Imperial ledger, a testament to the fragile nature of order in the face of absolute silence.

title: Mafia: The return of the godfather!
narrative_chronicle:
### Chapter 1: The Gathering at Number 9
The air in the Imperial City flats was thick with the stench of rot and neglected dreams. Lieutenant Elrohir arrived at Apartment 9, drawn by a desperate plea echoing through the hallways. Inside, a bloodied man whispered a dying warning: *“It has returned.”* The game was afoot. Twenty-one souls had been gathered, a mix of lawmen, medical personnel, and innocent townsfolk, all unaware that hidden among them were six cold-blooded mobsters and a lone, frenzied serial killer. As the doors locked, the hunt began.

### Chapter 2: First Blood
The city woke to a chilling discovery. The night had claimed its first victims: Arnor the officer and Jets, a townie caught in the crossfire of the underworld. Terror gripped the residents as they scrambled to identify the "Godfather," the mastermind pulling the strings. Amidst the chaos, suspicion fell upon FrozenICE. With a resounding consensus, the town sent the traitor to the gallows, hoping to purge the rot from within.

### Chapter 3: Web of Deceit
The darkness grew deeper. While the town cheered for the lynch of FrozenICE, the serial killer—a madman known as Nolio—was busy carving a path of carnage. Maarten met a gruesome end at the hands of the killer, his desperate defense with a broomstick failing against the blade. Soon, the town turned their rage upon Nolio himself. His confession was short and brutal, and he was hoisted to the noose, ending his spree, but leaving the Mafia’s true leadership firmly in control.

### Chapter 4: The Final Stand
The Mafia's reach proved longer than the town’s reach for justice. Parrot and Skyro were identified and executed by the town, but the cost was high. The Janitor struck, turning a victim into a gasoline-drenched torch, leaving the town traumatized. Gwynedd was found murdered, a victim of the shadowy figures still prowling the halls. In the end, as the dust settled on the ruins of the flats, only one figure stood amidst the carnage: **evilsheep**, the Mayor and the mastermind Godfather, having successfully liquidated the competition and secured absolute control over the city.

He had been all day in the hills west of Salem Valley, looking for doves and such small game as was in season. Late in the afternoon it had come on to be cloudy, and he had lost his bearings; and although he had only to go downhill, the absence of a trail and the sudden falling of night made it a tough walk down. Unable in the darkness to penetrate the thick bushes and undergrowth, utterly overcome with fatigue, he laid down near the root of a large oak tree. It was hours later, in the very middle of the night, that he heard a soft voice whispering his name.Glueeeee.. GlueeeeeGlue sat upright and peered into the darkness looking around. "It's late already, I should head back'" he mumbled as he jumped up. At least that was what he thought he was doing, but his legs seemed to think otherwise. A strange sensation began slowly to take possession of his body and his mind. He could not have said which, if any, of his senses was affected but he knew for sure that his legs were now totally numb. "wtf is this" he screamed.A sinister laughter arose from the darkness. "Oh Glue my boy, what are you doing alone in the woods. You feeling save there? well you shouldn't!"Glue cursed and tried to see who did this to him, he placed his hands against the oak tree and tried to pull himself up but his arms denied their service to his will, his arms fell to his sides. Too lifeless and too powerless to move or cry out, he found himself staring into dark eyes of his assailant who was now hovering above him, smiling the darkest smile he had ever seen. The strange sensation was starting to take total control and it was not long until there was no more sight and no more life... --- The phone rang from behind the bar. With a look, he dared anyone in the pub to answer it. On which he started to realise that he was completely alone in the pub. He shook his head as he bottomed his glass of brandy, "I should not drink so much" he thought as he yelled for the bartender. Meanwhile the phone had gone silent and he decided to return home. After pulling on his coat and yelling a farewell to the bartender in the back, he left the pub to face the inevitable cold journey home and headed to the subway.He arrived on the platform just as the first people were already gathering, waiting for the first train for work. Today was no different than any other day. The noise, the odors, the people aroused no interest for Jets. His only concern was his nice and warm bed.Behind him, on the stairs leading down from the street, Jets heard a commotion. Someone screamed. A man shouted, "He's got a gun!" As if in slow motion Jets turned as the hooded person raised the gun, pointing it at him. The man screamed something unintelligible before he fired his weapon. Jets saw the muzzle flash, felt the impact, and paused, stunned by disbelief then collapsed in a heap on the platform. From far away, as if down a tunnel, Jets heard voices, muffled, shouting. He could say the person running away in the commotion as darkness closed in. --- The night has ended and with the loss of two innocent townies, the town is now confronted with the seriousness of their situation. ### Chapter 1: The Gathering in the Square
The global credit crunch had reached even the most shadowed corners of the Imperial Conflict community, forcing a downsizing of epic proportions. In Paladgia Square, sixteen souls gathered under the watchful eyes of the moderators—Arsbury, Elrohir, and Eltara. Roles were cast by the cold precision of an Excel spreadsheet, dividing the group into a desperate Town, a hidden Mafia syndicate, and a solitary, drifting madman. The tension was palpable; as the sun dipped below the horizon, the town remained blissfully ignorant of the daggers hidden in the pockets of their neighbors.

### Chapter 2: The Sheriff’s Fall
The first light of day brought cold ironies. The town, fueled by suspicion and the desperate need to find a scapegoat, turned its collective gaze upon A10. In a swift, brutal display of democratic paranoia, they lynched the very man meant to protect them—the Sheriff. As A10’s true role was revealed, a chilling silence fell over the square. The Town’s eyes and ears had been plucked out by their own hands. In the cover of the following nights, the Mafia and the elusive Serial Killer began their work, carving a path of destruction through the ranks of the innocent and the guilty alike.

### Chapter 3: The Shadow War
The night phases became a slaughterhouse. While the Doctor, thirdrock, desperately tried to shield the innocent, the blades of the Mafia and the madness of the Serial Killer—Lexuzis—proved relentless. Mobsters Nolio and Undeath were discovered by the lynch mob and executed, but the Mafia hit back, silencing Townies one by one. Chaos reigned as the Godfather, SqueakySmit, desperately tried to maintain control of his operation, only to find himself hunted by a third party.

### Chapter 4: The Final Stand
As the dust settled, the magnitude of the carnage became clear. The Mafia’s structure had been shattered, with their Godfather falling to the blade of the Serial Killer. In a twist of fate, the lone madman, Lexuzis, had navigated the chaotic web of accusations and night-time bloodbaths to emerge as the last one standing. The Town had been decimated, and the Syndicate lay in ruin. The credit crunch had taken its toll—not just on the coffers of the town, but on its very existence. Lexuzis stood alone in the empty square, the victor of a game of shadows.

### Chapter 1: The Shadows of Brondane
The city of Brondane was a cesspool of secrets, a place where the rain never washed away the sins of the past. As the Lamiolo crime family tightened its grip, a silent war erupted in the back alleys. While the citizens slept, the IBI and GIA agents worked feverishly to dismantle the syndicate from the shadows. The atmosphere was thick with paranoia; every neighbor was a suspect, and every whisper in the dark could be a death sentence.

### Chapter 2: The Jailer’s Gambit
The town’s only hope for order lay in the hands of the Jailkeeper, Amok. In a bold, calculated move, the town rallied to sequester him, hoping to protect the one man who could secure their safety. Yet, the Serial Killer, Skyroshroud, lurked in the periphery—a phantom looking for blood. The town’s frantic attempts to identify the Mafia led to the brutal lynching of Eltara, Primo, and the secret operative GeneralSkulls, who had been feeding the syndicate intelligence from within.

### Chapter 3: The Web of Deceit
Betrayal became the currency of Brondane. While the Mafia successfully eliminated threats like SittingDuck and Nolio, their own ranks were thinning. The GIA agents, operating in absolute secrecy, took down Lexuzis in a tragic misfire, while the Serial Killer claimed Parrot before ultimately meeting his end by his own hand while incarcerated. The Godfather, Arnor, thought himself untouchable, protected by his illicit status, but the net was closing.

### Chapter 4: The Final Stand
The endgame turned into a bloodbath. As the Mafia’s numbers dwindled, the remaining syndicate members—Destroyyoutoo, TYMO, and the Godfather himself—were cornered. In a desperate, final shootout against the government agents, the criminal organization collapsed. The streets of Brondane fell silent at last. The town had survived, but at the cost of their protectors. The agents and the survivors stood amidst the wreckage, the long night finally yielding to a cold, uncertain dawn.

### Chapter 1: The Hollow Harbinger
The freighter mission to Ganymede was supposed to be a standard haul, but the cosmos had other plans. When an unidentified, perfectly round asteroid breached the titanium hull, the crew’s skepticism quickly turned to abject terror. It wasn’t a rock; it was a transport. Inside the wreckage lay nothing but a slick, alien residue and the promise of a nightmare. Within hours, the ship’s primary maintainer and doctor were found butchered, their remains a grotesque display of extraterrestrial intrusion. The "Mother Superior" and her infected brood had arrived, hiding in plain sight among the honest, terrified crew.

### Chapter 2: The Panic Room Gambit
As paranoia rippled through the decks like a contagion, the crew scrambled for order. With the Panic Room activated as the only sanctuary against the creeping shadows, the daily ritual of the Lynch became a trial by fire. Suspicion fell heavy on the vocal and the quiet alike. Early accusations were cast in haste—Primo found himself the subject of intense scrutiny, narrowly dodging the gallows through backroom conversations, while the crew’s frantic efforts to isolate the "Insane Crew Member"—a rogue killer stalking the halls—only led to more chaotic bloodletting.

### Chapter 3: Web of Deceit
The Biologists, struggling to find a thread of truth in the misinformation, were hunted with cold efficiency. As the Bodysnatchers systematically picked off the crew, the death toll mounted. The Insane Crew Member, A10, acted as a chaotic third party, carving his own bloody path until he was eventually silenced by those he sought to plague. The ship's halls became a tomb; the Mother Superior, Lyvidian, moved with the cunning of a predator, masquerading as a simple crew member while the infection spread through the air ducts.

### Chapter 4: The Final Stand
The endgame saw the crew’s numbers decimated. The few remaining survivors—those who had not been lynched or slaughtered in their sleep—realized too late that the corruption was absolute. Despite the desperate protection of the Panic Room and the occasional vigilante justice, the infection proved too resilient. The mission to Ganymede would never be completed; the freighter became a silent, drifting monument to a crew that failed to recognize the monster sitting at the dinner table.

## 🏆 Endgame Resolution & Role Reveals

Right! All roles have been allocated and sent out... so let's begin!!Good luck all, have a good game! --- Captain's log, January 20 2301:We're on our way to Ganymede, Jupiter's third moon. Estimated time of arrival: three weeks. We had some technical problems and even a hull breach, but our ship's maintainer's positive to repair them without much difficulty. What caused this unfortunate event, seems to be a small, asteroid-ish object. I say, asteroid-ish, as it has some peculiar aspects: it seems to be polished, perfectly round and it consists out of a material I've never seen before. We haven't had the chance to investigate it yet since the repairs are first priority, but I must admit I'm excited about this object. Excited and anxious, cause space is never a safe place to roam. --- Captain's log, January 21 2301:The object that crashed into our cargo freighter yesterday, seems to have fallen apart. It appears to be hollow on the inside, very strange indeed. To think a hollow object could breach our titanium hull without much trouble, yet seems to break apart by being exposed to mere oxygen. Inside we found nothing except a coat of slime, as if to soften the inner wall for a passenger, in case it should crash. The maintainer was able to repair the ship though, he was very eager to get it going again. He was restless and unable to sleep, but I suppose we can't complain he did an all-nighter.. --- Captain's log, January 22 2301:Now we know for sure. The object contained something malicious. The ship's maintainer and doctor were found dead, both beared similar odd marks: the eyes and nails had been removed from their bodies and their intestines lay draped over the entire room, as if some sort of ghastly bomb had exploded from their stomach. We found pieces of what appeared to be eggshells. I dread we've been attacked by bodysnatchers. They are no myth.. They've just entered this ship... How did we not realise from the start that that asteroid was a threat?Needless to say fear struck into the heart of my crew, although I must say people deal with it very differently: some succumb to panic and isolate themselves, only turning up when absolutely needed, others run around like headless chickens and then there are those who do what is needed to deal with this situation. The much-mocked bodysnatcher-procedures are instated. I have ordered to make the panic room empty and ready. No one's to leave their quarters, except when on duty. As our doctor has died, and with him all hope of curing an infected person, we decided that eliminating the infected crew is our only option. narrative_chronicle:
### Chapter 1: The Frostbitten Gathering
The snow fell thick over the village of Lapland, but the air was not filled with the warmth of holiday spirit. As the elves gathered beneath the giant Christmas tree, the mood was sour. Suspicion hung heavy in the air, sharper than the winter wind. Whispers echoed through the village: the Grinch had returned, and his Naughty Elves were hiding in plain sight, masquerading as kin while plotting the ultimate heist—the cancellation of Christmas itself.

### Chapter 2: The Grinch’s Fall
The town acted with uncharacteristic fervor, turning their collective gaze toward the suspicious *evilsheep*. Under the weight of mounting accusations, the self-proclaimed Grinch was cornered and lynched, dangling from the gallows as the first act of justice. But the celebration was short-lived. The Naughty Elves—led by the cunning trio of Maarten, Deci, and Arandur—were far from defeated. While the town congratulated themselves, the real architects of chaos were already pulling the strings from the shadows.

### Chapter 3: Web of Deceit
As the nights grew longer, the body count climbed. Scrooge, the wandering serial killer, claimed his own victims, while the Naughty Elves systematically dismantled the town’s leadership. Santa Claus himself, the heart of the village, was silenced in the night, his death a signal that the sanctuary of the North Pole had been breached. The town's protectors—the Santa’s Little Helpers and the wise Lexuzis—struggled to identify the threat, but they were playing a game rigged by the excel-born randomness of the dark.

### Chapter 4: The Final Stand
The endgame arrived in a flurry of violence under the boughs of the great tree. Lexuzis attempted one last desperate gambit, claiming to have unmasked the remaining conspirators. "I know who you are!" he shouted, pointing toward the shadows. But the elves were waiting. "He's behind you!" the mob cried, and with a single gunshot, Maarten ended the resistance. 

Chaos erupted. The village square turned into a war zone. GeneralSkulls narrowly escaped the toppling tree only to watch as the Naughty Elves hunted down the remaining innocents with ruthless efficiency. With the last of the "Nice" contingent falling to jagged glass and cold steel, the Christmas lights flickered and died. The Naughty Elves stood alone amidst the ruins, their bloody work complete. Christmas was over, and the Mafia reigned supreme.

title: IC Mafia 15: Take 2!!
narrative_chronicle:
### Chapter 1: The Dark Forest Inheritance
The kingdom of Gallador, already fractured by internal strife, faced a new existential threat. In a hidden cabin within the Quantum Forest, three infants were born of magical lineage, their destinies woven with ancient, dark power. Their mother’s sacrifice allowed them to be spirited away to the castle, but not before two were snatched by a shadowed figure seeking to cultivate them as weapons of darkness. As years passed, the "Sorcerer of Illusions" infiltrated the castle, his roots buried deep in a tragic past of servitude and revenge.

### Chapter 2: The Web of Deceit
The peace of the castle was a facade. The Traitors, led by the Sorcerer of Illusions, began a systematic purge. Knights fell in the pews of the church; the King’s advisors were struck down in the night. The townspeople, gripped by paranoia, engaged in the brutal rhythm of the lynching block. Accusations flew—Lexuzis and James|Sunstorm were cast under suspicion as the town struggled to distinguish between the King’s loyal subjects and the sleeper agents of the Traitor faction.

### Chapter 3: The Shattered Window
The tension reached a boiling point at the holy sanctuary. Undeath, a knight of the realm, fought valiantly against the encroaching shadows, but was overwhelmed when the very architecture of the church was weaponized against him. The stained-glass depiction of the dragon-slayer shattered, burying the knight under the weight of history and cold steel. The Traitors high-fived in the ruins, but their arrogance began to attract the gaze of forces they could not control.

### Chapter 4: The Final Stand
As the Traitor known as the Seducer unleashed ancient, stone-like warriors from a cursed chest, the courtyard descended into chaos. Lynns, the faithful cleric, met a silent end, strangled with her own crucifix. However, the King’s subjects—arms, evilsheep, and the Prince, SittingDuck—refused to yield. As the stone warriors tore through the royal guard, a mysterious Oracle descended, obliterating the unholy statues with bolts of blue light. In the final confrontation, the King was struck down, but in his dying breath, he revealed the truth: his heir, SittingDuck, was the key to the kingdom's survival. The Traitors were purged, and the crown passed to a new, battle-hardened sovereign.

--- - 30 years from present dayA woman's scream erupted from the log cabin buried deep within the confines of Quantum Forest. Although it was mid afternoon, the giant oak trees which populated the wood cast an eerie dark shadow across everything within and shut out almost all natural daylight. The high-pitched scream echoed through the forest walls and then stopped as suddenly as it started. A large tawny owl perched on the high branch of a tree close to the cabin turned its head and hooted loudly in response. It spread its wings and flew off towards another tree when its hoot was met with the shrill sound of a baby crying.Inside the cabin, a woman was laying on the hard wooden floor. She was sweating profusely and appeared to be in pain. Standing before her was another woman holding the crying baby. Taking a soft white blanket lying on a nearby stool, the woman wrapped the baby up and placed him on a bed located to her right where a second baby was lying, wrapped in another white blanket. "Ok it is time to push again Maggie, the last one is coming!!"Another scream erupted from the cabin as the mother pushed once more.An hour later, the woman was lying in bed with her three newly born children quietly sleeping next to her. She looked both exhausted and delighted at the same time. The other woman was pacing up and down impatiently. "Once you have your rest, we'll have to go! Your husband won't be able to withstand much more torture before gives away our location. You know how precious these babies are, they're going to want them." she said."I know Mary, I know that these babies were born of magical blood - I just feel so tired and I'm hurting so much. We will leave after a couple of hours sleep. Blow out those candles and get some rest. Richard cast a protection charm over this cabin many years ago, we won't be disturbed. I'm just so tired...."The moon had just crept over the top of the forest when a loud explosion rocked the floor of the cabin. The triplets started crying immediately, annoyed at being disturbed from their slumber. Mary screamed as she noticed the back of the cabin had been totally blown away. Smoke and dust from the rubble entered the cabin as she saw the dark silhouette of a cloaked man walking towards them. Maggie sat up and raised her arms. Her outstretched palms faced the back of the cabin which was now revealed to the outside world. She mumbled a few words to herself and a faint white beam of light omitted from her palms together with a soft humming sound. The beams stretched forwards to form a wall of light in place of the log wall."Quickly Mary, take the babies! Head to the castle where they will be safe. The king will make sure they have all the support they need to take them in the right direction. GO! I don't think I can hold this forcefield for much longer!" she managed to say whilst keeping the wall of light intact. Mary immediately reached over and took the babies into her arms. She ran towards the cabin door and looked back as the cloaked figure had raised his arms also and an opposing wall of green light had been generated in retaliation.Mary ran from the cabin and directly into the dark forest whilst struggling with the three babies in her arms. They were wailing as loud as ever, unaware of the drama around them. After a few moments of running, another loud explosion echoed through the wood and she stopped momentarily to turn around. She knew that Maggie's strength must have run out. She placed the triplets down softly on a pile on leaves next to a tree and thought of her next move. The castle was another few miles of trekking through this rough terrain and she knew she wasn't going to make it whilst carrying all three. She took another pile of leaves and placed them on two of the babies, concealing them from sight. "I'll be back for you little ones" she said as she kissed each one on the forehead. She took the third baby into her arms and ran into the distance towards the castle.The cloaked figure walked quickly towards the faint sound of crying, hopeful that he would find what he sought. The faces of two newborn babies looked up at him as he removed a pile of leaves. Two out of the three newborn children of the recently deceased sorcerer lineage was good enough for him. He smiled as he picked them up and they stopped crying. "I have a lot to teach you" he muttered as he walked off.- 15 years from present day"Kill it boy!" the old man said. "I taught you this curse years ago, you will be lashed if you have forgotten it!"The boy looked puzzled at the puppy staring up at him. It was true. He had been taught from a very early age to perfect the gift that he had been born with and now that he was 15, he knew most of the dark magic curses that his master had taught him."I know it master!" another boy said as he pushed past his brother and pointed a finger at the dog whilst mumbling a few words. A shot of green light beamed from his finger tip and hit the dog, who keeled over immediately with a faint yelp. "Good boy" the master said approvingly and smiled. "Now you told me you wanted to learn about illusions - come along then! Your stupid brother must stay here and scrub the floor." They walked off as the "stupid "brother looked on.The boy wasn't going to take anymore of this. His brother was always the one who got the praise. There was no reason to stick around anymore. ### 🗳️ Vote Tally & Lynch Announcement (25-Nov-2008 21:07:41)

--- The church was a bleak building when empty. Every sunday morning the rows of pews would be filled with chattering members of Gallador's finest, ready to pledge their allegiance to God and the King. But no longer. Ever since the first attack on the King over a week ago, the pews stood empty as people were afraid to venture to the castle. They were aware that great evil had penetrated its walls.Undeath walked along the aisle and thought of all the friendly people he had met within these walls. None more so than the cleric. He owed the cleric his life - two times over - and it was now his duty to stay at the church to protect the man of God as well as for his own safety. Undeath looked up at the stained glass windows surrounding the great building and then looked directly upwards at the centrepoint of the whole church - a huge window of stained glass suspended horizontally above the pews and altar stared down at him.The image depicted the great Battle of Gallador where King Stefan IV killed the dragon. A sea of colour beamed into the room whenever the sun was shining, but right now all was dark.The cleric had left the church moments earlier to attend to some business this evening and Undeath paced up and down the church aisle wondering what to do with himself. A jagged bruise was apparent along his neck where he was strangled by a copper wire the previously evening. He knew they would eventually come back.That was the reason why he wasn't at all surprised when he turned around to see a traitor, draped in a long black cloak, standing at the altar with a sword outstretched. "Haha, I've come to finish the job" he shouted as he slowly made his way up the aisle.Undeath span around quickly towards the doors of the great church where he knew two suits of armour were standing like warriors, guarding the entrance to God's house. He glanced at one of the knights and smiled cheekily as he slid the sword from its light grasp. He then turned around to face the traitor."En garde!" he shouted. Darting forwards, the sword fight began. Clinks of metal echoed throughout the church as sword met sword in every direction whilst man and traitor fought for their lives. Undeath dodged and attacked like he was a natural - almost as if he was trained for combat - but his opponent was almost equally as proficient. They continued to battle, moving backwards and forwards down the central aisle of the church. However, a bad mistake from the traitor saw him trip and fall backwards, with his sword flying off into the distance, clattering as it landed on the ground. Undeath moved forward for the final swipe of his sword but was interrupted when he was stabbed from behind. Another blade pertruded from the centre of his body as a different traitor had fatally joined the fight.The traitor pulled the blade out quickly and Undeath collapsed to his knees before falling forwards. The defeated traitor swordsman got to his feet and surged forward to congratulate his friend who could not have chosen a better moment to intervene. They high-fived each other but when they turned back around, Undeath's body had disappeared."Impossible!! Find him!!" a traitor shouted as they darted down the aisle, running in opposite directions at the front of the church. As the traitor approached the back of the altar, he noticed a pair of legs disappear from a ladder which led up to the second level of the church. He quickly followed, taking each rung of the ladder carefully. Fresh blood had stained most of them making it tricky. When he reached the top, the view almost took his breath away.He was standing in line with the horizontal stained glass window. From his position, he could see the whole church through the different pieces of coloured glass. The traitor realised the ladder must be used as some sort of cleaning platform to wash the glass and noticed immediately that Undeath was slowly tredding across it, trying to reach the other side.The traitor thought of his next steps with ease as he took a brick from the platform he was standing on and threw it towards the injured man. Undeath dodged the brick with ease but didn't anticipate the next event. The brick flew through the air and hit the glass with a crack. A splitsecond later and the whole piece of glass began to shatter with a cracking noise. Undeath lost his footing and his balance and fell, together with the shattering glass towards the stone floor of the church.A loud smashing sound rang through the building as the entire stained window came down, showering into a million pieces of multicoloured shards of glass. Undeath lay in the middle of it all. After cracking a number of ribs, broken his arm, hip and leg, he was also cut throughout the length of his body with glass piercing almost every piece of bare skin. But he was still breathing.Undeath coughed and a stream of blood trickled out of his mouth and down his scarred face. He painfully began to muster up the energy to crawl slowly in the direction of the church doors, willing himself to get away.The second traitor, however, was walking up the aisle, sword in hand. "WTF?! Why won't you bloody die?!!" he shouted angrily as he swung the sword promptly. Undeath's head was removed in one swoop and span around briefly on the spot. There was no one around to protect the knight tonight. --- It is now --- DAY --- All remaining castle citizens have until 12:00 GMT on Wednesday to post their lynch votes!

### 🌙 Night / Day Narrative Scene (26-Nov-2008 22:38:32)

--- It was time.The remaining traitor witnessed the death of Chees right before his eyes and immediately left the courtyard. He knew what he had to do. Running up the spiral staircase, he reached the familiar corridor which led to a number of chambers. Walking to the end, he took out a key from within his robes, unlocked the door and stepped into the now-vacated room of the Sorcerer of Illusions.Many nights ago when they found the voodoo doll of jesnt within the sorcerer's wardrobe, they also found a chest. Encrusted with a pure silver skull, the chest was bound by a magical curse which prevented them from opening it. After being retold the night's events by Gladiator, the seducer knew that he would be the only traitor to be able to break the curse but didn't say anything, hoping to reserve it for a better time. And so there he was, knelt down in front of the wardrobe, looking at the mysterious chest.The seducer ran his finger along the outline of the skull and as if by magic, a click sounded from within. He smiled as he placed both of his hands along each side and wedged the box open. Peering inside, he frowned as he found a number of toys - two pairs of identical looking stone warriors on horseback to be precise. He blew along the top of the toys and a layer of dust flew into the air. As he did, a couple of drops of saliva came out of his mouth and landed on one of the models. This strangely caused some of the stone to crack and a soft sizzling sound had started. The traitor took the toys out of the chest and placed them on the ground. He reached beside him and grabbed a vial of water which stood on the desk. Standing up, he poured the water onto the stone warriors. The sizzling sound suddenly appeared much louder and the traitor edged backwards quickly as the chambers began to rumble...Back in the courtyard, an argument had broken out between the king's subjects. They were crowded in a huddle, unaware that one of them had disappeared into the castle. "Don't you dare call me a traitor! I'm not one of them!" Sunstorm declared to the group. "Ha! That's what they all say" TMK shot back. evilsheep and arms looked at each other before announcing their agreement with TMK. "Let's lynch tomorrow!" they said in unison.This is when Lynns stepped in. "We're sticking with the list Undeath gave us. It's either Sunstorm or Ilfirin and we'll start with James" she said. "Nooooooooooo!" Sunstorm screamed as he stepped back and drew a sword. The crowd backed up and arms and evilsheep also took out their swords. "No, I mean turn around! Behind you!" Sunstorm shouted.They span around and saw, with complete surprise, four men on horseback standing towards the entrance of the castle. They were at least 10ft tall but didn't seem real. They were grey in colour and were armed with long steel swords. Their dark horses looked unearthly as they breathed in the cold night air. Suddenly they began to charge forwards.Shouting aloud, the king's subjects dispersed in different directions. Lynns looked around frantically as she ran towards the side. She had to find TMK. Reaching a number of stone columns, she hid behind one whilst she scanned the courtyard for the person she wanted to protect.The centre of the courtyard was a flurry of action. arms and SittingDuck were battling one warrior, whilst evilsheep was attempting to dodge the sword swipes from two. TMK and Sunstorm were tackling the other. Lynns caught sight of this battle and grabbed onto her crucifix. But it wasn't there. She looked down at her robes and could not find the golden chain. She was then pulled backwards as she realised where the chain had gone - it was now around her neck. The traitor grabbed onto both ends and pulled as hard as he could. Lynns kicked and grabbed with her arms as she struggled to breathe. A few moments later and her body went limp. The traitor released the chain and the cleric fell to the ground. Her face had turned a slight shade of purple as all the oxygen had been starved from it. The life had disappeared from her eyes.A shattering sound erupted through the courtyard as TMK and Sunstorm cheered. They had managed to make the horse they were attacking lose balance and fall to the ground, taking its warrior with them. As it made impact, the stone exploded into a thousand pieces showering everywhere. Sunstorm bent down to pick up some of the pieces and then coughed violently into his hand. Blood was spewing out of his mouth. He looked down at his chest and found the tip of TMK's sword. "Die traitor!" TMK said as he released the sword. "You've got it all wrong" Sunstorm managed to splutter as he fell forwards."Hahaha, oh yes! All wrong!" came a voice from behind TMK. He span around and saw Ilfirin holding a sword in one hand and Lynns' golden crucifix in the other. "WTF?!" TMK said as he realised what he had done. Angrily, he picked up his sword and began to duel the final traitor.Shouts echoed through other parts of the courtyard as evilsheep had been thrown to the ground. The warrior trotted over towards him and lifted his sword ready to deal the final blow. At that moment, a shot of blue light sped across the yard, whooshing past TMK's swordfight and the other two subjects. The beam was directly at the centre of the warrior and resulted in a great crashing sound as the stone attacker was smashed into smitherines.SittingDuck, arms and their own attacker stopped their fight to see what had caused the awesome blow.At the foot of the courtyard, stood a wrinkly old man with hair as white as snow and eyes as blue as the sea. He had both of his arms outstretched with a single finger pointed at the two remaining warriors. Further blue beams shot out at supersonic speeds caused even more debris to fly through the air as they obliterated them.Pleased at his work, he had one more job to do. He moved to face the final remaining battle - but this one had already been won. A figure had slumped to the ground gripping the wound in his stomach where the sword had entered. TMK hit the ground in pain as his attacker back away slowly. With glazed over blue eyes, stared directly at Ilfirin who had now moved into a sprint, attempting to run away from the Oracle's stare. It was no use. The shot of blue light was too fast as it struck him in the back, killing him instantly.TMK lay on the floor breathing his last gasps of air when a glow of white light omitted around him. His face began to change shape and morph into something else. SittingDuck, who was watching from metres away realised what had happened and immediately ran forward towards TMK. "Nooooooooooo! Father!" he shouted with immense shock. arms and evilsheep followed slowly.As SittingDuck bent down in front of his dying father, a white glow started omitting from him also. His appearance altered dramatically to reveal an image of true royalty - the Prince of Gallador. "Take care my son" King TMK uttered as he gripped his heir's hand. "The traitors have been removed and you will have a successful reign." SittingDuck sobbed as the grip on his hand loosened and eventually fell away.arms and evilsheep put their hands on his shoulders and said "All hail King SittingDuck!"The new king smiled briefly as he looked at the mess around him and then up at the Oracle who was watching from the foot of the courtyard. It seems Gallador will be fine after all. --- GAME OVER!!Congrats to arms, evilsheep and SittingDuck for winning IC Mafia 15b for the town!!To make things clear, I've ended it now because I was told Lynns would die tonight and then Sunstorm lynched, followed by TMK dying the following night and Ilfirin, the final mobster, being killed off tomorrow.But anyways, on behalf of Elro and myself, I'd like to thank all those who played this game actively and for making it into one of the most fun mafia games I've had in a long time! Hope you all have enjoyed it too!Next game will not be until next month so keep an eye out for details!Final Player List1. A10 - KNIGHT - MURDERED BY TRAITORS2. arms - KING'S SUBJECT - SURVIVED3. ### Chapter 1: The Gathering
In the shadowed confines of Quantum Forest, a sorcerous lineage was fractured by violence. As the cabin walls crumbled under the assault of a mysterious, cloaked shadow, the triplets—born of magical blood—were scattered to the winds. The King’s castle became the final sanctuary, but the encroaching darkness followed. From the shadows, the Traitors—led by the Sorcerer of Illusions, Arocalex—infiltrated the kingdom, while the Sorcerer of Death, Eltara, stalked the halls with his own lethal agenda. The air in the castle grew thick with suspicion; the King’s subjects, blind to the true identities of their neighbors, began to turn upon one another.

### Chapter 2: First Blood
The castle gates were no shield against the encroaching dread. In the night, the Sorcerer of Light, Amok, fell victim to a coordinated Traitor strike, his wisdom lost to the void. Gladiator, a loyal subject, found no safety in his innocence, falling instead to the blade of the Sorcerer of Death. As the sun rose on the first day, the paranoia reached a fever pitch. In the chaotic debates of the courtyard, accusations flew like arrows. Humidity, a vocal subject, was dragged to the gallows by a suspicious mob, yet the blood on their hands proved to be that of an innocent.

### Chapter 3: Web of Deceit
The traitors thrived in the confusion. Jets, the elusive Abductor, spirited away the Prince, You_Fool, silencing a key piece of the resistance before he could reveal the true hierarchy of the court. The Knights, RockOn and Suicidal Sushi, attempted to pierce the veil of deception, but the Sorcerer of Illusions cast his spell of falsehood, twisting their findings and leading them down a path of ruin. Another innocent soul, Lynns, was sacrificed to the lynch mob's frenzy, further depleting the ranks of the King’s loyalists.

### Chapter 4: The Final Stand
As the Traitors moved to finish their conquest, the castle became a tomb. With the King’s advisor dead, the Prince abducted, and the Knights misled, the remaining subjects were hopelessly outmaneuvered. The Sorcerer of Illusions and his cabal executed their final maneuvers with clinical precision, silencing the remaining voices of dissent. The reign of light was extinguished, and the dark sorcery of the forest claimed the throne.

## 📜 Opening Briefing & Lore
*Original opening by Moderator **[TI] arsbury***

--- - 30 years from present dayA woman's scream erupted from the log cabin buried deep within the confines of Quantum Forest. Although it was mid afternoon, the giant oak trees which populated the wood cast an eerie dark shadow across everything within and shut out almost all natural daylight. The high-pitched scream echoed through the forest walls and then stopped as suddenly as it started. A large tawny owl perched on the high branch of a tree close to the cabin turned its head and hooted loudly in response. It spread its wings and flew off towards another tree when its hoot was met with the shrill sound of a baby crying.Inside the cabin, a woman was laying on the hard wooden floor. She was sweating profusely and appeared to be in pain. Standing before her was another woman holding the crying baby. Taking a soft white blanket lying on a nearby stool, the woman wrapped the baby up and placed him on a bed located to her right where a second baby was lying, wrapped in another white blanket. "Ok it is time to push again Maggie, the last one is coming!!"Another scream erupted from the cabin as the mother pushed once more.An hour later, the woman was lying in bed with her three newly born children quietly sleeping next to her. She looked both exhausted and delighted at the same time. The other woman was pacing up and down impatiently. "Once you have your rest, we'll have to go! Your husband won't be able to withstand much more torture before gives away our location. You know how precious these babies are, they're going to want them." she said."I know Mary, I know that these babies were born of magical blood - I just feel so tired and I'm hurting so much. We will leave after a couple of hours sleep. Blow out those candles and get some rest. Richard cast a protection charm over this cabin many years ago, we won't be disturbed. I'm just so tired...."The moon had just crept over the top of the forest when a loud explosion rocked the floor of the cabin. The triplets started crying immediately, annoyed at being disturbed from their slumber. Mary screamed as she noticed the back of the cabin had been totally blown away. Smoke and dust from the rubble entered the cabin as she saw the dark silhouette of a cloaked man walking towards them. Maggie sat up and raised her arms. Her outstretched palms faced the back of the cabin which was now revealed to the outside world. She mumbled a few words to herself and a faint white beam of light omitted from her palms together with a soft humming sound. The beams stretched forwards to form a wall of light in place of the log wall."Quickly Mary, take the babies! Head to the castle where they will be safe. The king will make sure they have all the support they need to take them in the right direction. GO! I don't think I can hold this forcefield for much longer!" she managed to say whilst keeping the wall of light intact. Mary immediately reached over and took the babies into her arms. She ran towards the cabin door and looked back as the cloaked figure had raised his arms also and an opposing wall of green light had been generated in retaliation.Mary ran from the cabin and directly into the dark forest whilst struggling with the three babies in her arms. They were wailing as loud as ever, unaware of the drama around them. After a few moments of running, another loud explosion echoed through the wood and she stopped momentarily to turn around. She knew that Maggie's strength must have run out. She placed the triplets down softly on a pile on leaves next to a tree and thought of her next move. The castle was another few miles of trekking through this rough terrain and she knew she wasn't going to make it whilst carrying all three. She took another pile of leaves and placed them on two of the babies, concealing them from sight. "I'll be back for you little ones" she said as she kissed each one on the forehead. She took the third baby into her arms and ran into the distance towards the castle.The cloaked figure walked quickly towards the faint sound of crying, hopeful that he would find what he sought. The faces of two newborn babies looked up at him as he removed a pile of leaves. Two out of the three newborn children of the recently deceased sorcerer lineage was good enough for him. He smiled as he picked them up and they stopped crying. "I have a lot to teach you" he muttered as he walked off.- 15 years from present day"Kill it boy!" the old man said. "I taught you this curse years ago, you will be lashed if you have forgotten it!"The boy looked puzzled at the puppy staring up at him. It was true. He had been taught from a very early age to perfect the gift that he had been born with and now that he was 15, he knew most of the dark magic curses that his master had taught him."I know it master!" another boy said as he pushed past his brother and pointed a finger at the dog whilst mumbling a few words. A shot of green light beamed from his finger tip and hit the dog, who keeled over immediately with a faint yelp. "Good boy" the master said approvingly and smiled. "Now you told me you wanted to learn about illusions - come along then! Your stupid brother must stay here and scrub the floor." They walked off as the "stupid "brother looked on.The boy wasn't going to take anymore of this. His brother was always the one who got the praise. There was no reason to stick around anymore. He knew everything he needed to know and could perfect his skills on his own. It was time to leave. He gathered some things together and walked out of the house without looking back. He was heading straight for the castle.- 2 years from present dayThe man looked at his master pitifully. He had lived with him for the last 28 years but now he had no need for him. The tables had turned and it was the master who needed him now. He clicked his fingers and a green flash of light knocked his master to the ground. He was dead on impact. "Thanks for everything, but it's time for me to take my future into my own hands" the man grabbed the master's cloak and pulled it around himself before making his way towards the castle. Tomorrow, his work begins... ---
